# JetBrains Marketplace — Store Description

Use the HTML below as the plugin description for the JetBrains Marketplace listing.

---

```html
<h2>Monitor, score, and clean up your Git branches — right inside your IDE</h2>

<p>
  Branch Health Dashboard gives every Git branch a health score from 0 to 100.
  It tracks branch age, monitors activity, predicts merge conflicts, and recommends
  the best merge strategy — all without leaving your editor. Stop letting stale
  branches silently accumulate risk.
</p>

<h3>Branch Health Scoring</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Health score (0–100)</b> — A single number that tells you how healthy each branch is, based on age, activity, behind-count, and conflict risk.</li>
  <li><b>Color-coded status</b> — Healthy (≥75, green), Aging (≥50, yellow), Stale (≥25, orange), Dead (&lt;25, red).</li>
  <li><b>Score breakdown</b> — Age (up to −40 pts), Activity (+10 to −10 pts), Behind count (up to −15 pts), Conflict risk (up to −20 pts, Pro).</li>
</ul>

<h3>Branch Monitoring</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Age tracking</b> — See how old each branch is at a glance. Color-coded: Healthy ≤7 days, Aging 7–30 days, Stale &gt;30 days.</li>
  <li><b>Activity heatmap</b> — Commits-per-day visualization with trend indicators for each branch.</li>
  <li><b>Stale branch detection</b> — Configurable thresholds (7, 14, 30, 60, or 90 days) with balloon notifications when branches go stale.</li>
  <li><b>Branch comparison</b> — Ahead/behind counts against the base branch so you know exactly how far each branch has drifted.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Tool Window Dashboard</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Sortable table</b> — Sort branches by health score, age, or activity.</li>
  <li><b>Filter by status</b> — Show only Healthy, Aging, Stale, or Dead branches.</li>
  <li><b>All branches in one view</b> — Local and remote branches displayed together with full metrics.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Conflict prediction</b> — Detects common files across branches and assigns a risk level: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL.</li>
  <li><b>Rebase advisor</b> — Recommends the optimal merge strategy for each branch: REBASE, MERGE, or EITHER.</li>
  <li><b>Cleanup automation</b> — Batch-delete merged branches with dry-run support. Protected branches (main, master, develop) are never removed.</li>
  <li><b>Orphan commit detection</b> — Finds commits that are no longer reachable from any branch.</li>
  <li><b>Enhanced notifications</b> — Team notifications and branch policy enforcement to keep everyone aligned.</li>
</ul>

  </tr>

      </ul>
    </td>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 or later (builds 243–252.*)</li>
  <li>Git4Idea plugin (bundled with IntelliJ IDEA)</li>
  <li>Java 17+</li>
</ul>
```
